name: Composite Error Map and Densification/Pruning Scoring
definition: A density control mechanism that uses a frequency-aware mask and photometric loss to compute densification and pruning scores for Gaussian primitives, reducing redundancy and improving fidelity compared to vanilla 3DGS.
summary: A 3D Gaussian Splatting density control mechanism that computes densification and pruning scores using a composite error mask and photometric loss to reduce redundancy and improve fidelity.
